cover: Building for people on a hard day

slides.title: Ask one thing at a time
slides.body: The application asks one group of questions at a time, so nobody faces a long form while grieving.

slides.title: Offer words first
slides.body: A memorial wish shows a few preset phrases before an empty box. A blank box is hard to fill on a bad day.

slides.title: Get the date right
slides.body: Anniversaries are Hebrew dates, worked out fresh each year with the leap-year rule, with reminders before the day.

slides.title: Her record is hers
slides.body: Closing an account is her request. Erasing her details later leaves the memorial to her parent in place.

slides.title: Let the software keep rules
slides.body: With no engineers on staff, tests, contrast and permissions are rules the software enforces itself.
